name: Roll-A-Ball Epic
author: Unity Play
description:
Tour a spacey world in my Roll-A-Ball minigame! 
 
Made with the Beginner Scripting course.  This was a fun tutorial. I even tried to bake the lighting (from the Creative Core lessons) but I'm still learning. It gave strange results, especially on the lower section.    

Move around with the arrow keys.
Collect treasure and explore.


Free assets from the Unity store:

Yughues - Pillars
Yughues - Pavement and Concrete Materials 
Aurynsky - Gems
Laxer - Modular Wooden Bridges
Vis Games - Books
L2S Arts - Stylized Hand Painted Dungeon
Dinv Studio - Dynamic Space Background
Unity Technologies - 3D Game Kit Environment Pack
